name: badge
title: Badge
description: Inline status badge with Mason variant styling hooks.

meta.customization: Customize color and shape through mason-badge classes and data-variant.

parity.baseUi: Base UI has no first-class Badge primitive, so parity is scoped to Mason display semantics: stable root element, variant metadata, and class/data styling hooks. Gaps: status role guidance, icon slots, removable badge behavior, and accessibility examples remain follow-up work.
parity.kobalte: Comparable to Kobalte Badge as a Solid display part with polymorphic composition potential and styling hooks. Gaps: Keystone/Mason does not yet expose a dedicated as-polymorphic API, semantic status presets, or design-token metadata.
